My team works in three offices: Singapore, London and Brazil. When we started, our weekly calls were a disaster. The people in London spoke very fast, the people in Singapore were too polite to ask questions, and the people in Brazil said yes to everything. Nobody was lying. They just did not want to interrupt. So we created one rule. After every important decision, one person paraphrases it, starting with: so, what we are saying is. It takes thirty seconds. Since then, we have had almost no misunderstandings about dates or numbers.

Okay, quick update before we jump off. The IC signed off on the deal subject to CPs, so we are basically good to go, but the DSCR came in a bit tight, so the lenders want a DSRA of six months instead of three. Legal is on it. We are targeting financial close by end of Q1, assuming the regulator does not move the goalposts on the tariff reset. If anybody has questions, now is the time, because I have a hard stop in two minutes.
